$comment: Round 4 group B: a Text's `runs` (inline spans) and `dropCap`, THE rule src/text-runs.ts implements and every renderer replays (Rust eui-core `text_runs` + the layout tree, Swift `TextRuns`, Kotlin `TextRuns`, React + Solid via the TS reference). RUNS: an array REPLACES `text` (an empty one shows nothing; anything else = no runs, `text` shows): one paragraph of spans wrapping together, measured and painted as ONE styled string. A run = a string (`{text}`) or `{text, weight?, tone?, mark?, link?}`; `text` a string, number or boolean (the display string); an unknown weight/tone/mark or an empty link drops the attribute; empty or textless runs drop; adjacent runs with equal attributes merge (`normalCases`: `out` = the normal form, `text` = the joined text). The core (eui-core layout tree) hands the natives `runs` in the normal form and `text` = the joined text, so every measurer, a11y name, FixedMeasure (8 px per character of the joined text) and search sees it. PAINT ×5, each run over the Text's own type (its variant's recipe, `align`, the node style): `weight` = `$type.weight.<w>` (unset = the variant's); `tone` = the colour Text/root paints under that `tone` (unset = the Text's ink); mark `highlight` = a `$color.match` fill in the GLYPH box behind the run (text-highlight.json's box: the font's own ascent and descent around the baseline, sliced per line), the search marks paint over it; `code` = markdown-inline.json `documentPaint.code` (the Markdown/code recipe: mono, its size, fill, radius, paddingHorizontal reserved in the line; ONE unbreakable pill, never split across lines); `strike` / `underline` = a 1 px line-through / underline in the run's colour; `link` = when the host URL policy allows it, underlined in the run's colour (the #EXP-1674 text link look), a press opens it through the host exactly like Link `href` and never presses a pressable parent (no Text event fires); denied = plain text. `textTransform` applies per run; runs (and a drop cap) paint START-aligned (`align` and a node `textAlign` apply to plain text only). With runs: `highlight` (search) matches over the joined text, across run edges, like a Markdown paragraph; `lines` / `truncate: end` clamp the paragraph with an ellipsis; `truncate: middle` acts as `end`; `shimmer` paints the joined text plain in the sweep (runs ignored); `hostLinks` is ignored. DROP CAP (`linesCases`): `dropCap` = the lines the first letter spans, rounded and clamped to `dropCap.min`..`max` (below min = none; `true` = `dropCap.lines`); none under `lines` > 0, `truncate` or `shimmer`. Works on `text` (one run) and `runs`. `splitCases`: leading ASCII spaces, tabs and line breaks drop; the cap = the first scalar plus the combining marks (U+0300–036F, 1AB0–1AFF, 1DC0–1DFF, 20D0–20FF, FE20–FE2F) and variation selectors (FE0E, FE0F) right after it, in the weight and tone of the run holding it (never its mark or link); `rest` = the runs after it; search still runs over the whole joined text, but the cap itself never paints a fill (a match across it paints from the rest on). `sizeCases`: the cap's font size = round(fontSize + (lines − 1) × lineHeight × `ratio`), the family the Text's; its BOX = `lines` × lineHeight tall, the cap's advance + `gap` wide, at the inline-start edge (RTL: the right), the glyph's baseline by CSS half-leading in that box (ascent + (box − ascent − descent) / 2). LAYOUT (web = a CSS float, the natives reproduce it): the rest wraps at (width − cap box) for its first `lines` lines, beside the cap, then at the full width; a line whose first unbreakable segment does not fit beside the cap starts below the box; the height = max(box, the lines). Intrinsics: max-content = cap box + the rest's max-content (its height = the box); min-content = max(cap box, the rest's widest unbreakable segment). FixedMeasure: the cap is one 8 px character and the height is max(lines × 20, its own).

normalCases.name: numbers and booleans show as display strings
a link merges only with the same link

splitCases.name: the cap takes the run's weight and tone, never its mark or link
combining marks stay with the cap
a supplementary scalar is one cap
